## What's changed

- Kept Recently Added tidy by returning one card per television series instead of flooding the shelf with every episode from a new import.
- Added the exact newly imported episode or episode batch to modern-player responses, allowing one new episode to open directly and larger batches to open at the correct season and starting episode.
- Recorded a stable first-seen time for indexed media so later metadata changes do not make older titles appear newly added.
- The new response data is optional and backward compatible, so existing Steam and retro players continue using their current browsing behavior.
